name: CraveAI — Workflow A: Restaurant & Menu Search

nodes.name: Menu Search Webhook
nodes.notes: POST JSON body: query (required), cuisine, area, restaurant_name, max_item_price (PKR per item), limit.

nodes.name: Validate Search Request
nodes.notes: Checks query and optional filters. Default limit 10, max 25. Invalid input -> 400 response.

nodes.name: Read Restaurants Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads all rows from the Restaurants tab. Errors continue so the search step can return a safe 502.

nodes.name: Read Menu Items Sheet
nodes.notes: Runs once and reads all rows from the Menu_Items tab.

nodes.name: Join, Filter & Rank Results
nodes.notes: Joins menu items to active restaurants by restaurant_id, applies filters, ranks (item-name match first, signature as tie-breaker), dedupes and formats JSON.

nodes.name: Respond to Caller
nodes.notes: Returns body with statusCode (200 results, 400 invalid request, 502 database error, 500 internal error).
